feedback.problem:
Find the characteristic equation of the matrix 
$B=[\begin{aligned}8 & 10 & 0 \\ -5 & -7 & 0 \\ 6 & -9 & 3\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we find the matrix $\,B-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
B-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}8-\lambda  & 10 & 0 \\ -5 & -7-\lambda  & 0 \\ 6 & -9 & 3-\lambda \end{aligned}]
$$

The characteristic equation is $det(B-\lambda I)=0.$ 

Expanding the determinant across the $3$rd column, we obtain the following:  

$$
\begin{aligned}det(B-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}8-\lambda  & 10 & 0 \\ -5 & -7-\lambda  & 0 \\ 6 & -9 & 3-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (3-\lambda )|\begin{aligned}8-\lambda  & 10 \\ -5 & -7-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (3-\lambda )((8-\lambda )(-7-\lambda )-(-5)(10)) & =0 \\ (3-\lambda )({\lambda }^{2}-\lambda -6) & =0 \\ (\lambda -3)(\lambda -3)(\lambda +2) & =0\end{aligned}
$$
